ownership.hermes_core: Hermes owns the conversation loop, prompt cache, gateway and core tools.
ownership.aiask_edge: AIASK owns finance services exposed through its local HTTP plugin and optional MCP servers.

rules: Hermes core must not import aiask_agent, akshare_mcp or strategy_factory.
Hermes core must not dynamically import those packages either (importlib.import_module / __import__ with a string), because a static import scan cannot see a string.
The Hermes AIASK plugin communicates with AIASK through allowlisted loopback HTTP routes or optional MCP manifests.
The legacy ThreadingHTTPServer is compatibility-only and may only be selected explicitly with --legacy-http.
Fragment-loader and *_parts packaging are retired; new code must use ordinary importable modules only.
The four-factory control plane is owned by the aiask CLI. Host commands (hermes aiask factory ...) must delegate to it, not re-implement orchestration.
SignalTracker is a sidecar and is never counted as one of the four factories.
Decoupling claims must be backed by an executable test, not only by an import scan.

package_dag.notes: Verified 2026-08-28 by import scan: acyclic, and akshare_mcp reaches strategy_factory only through .api.*/.runtime.* public surfaces (zero application/infrastructure/domain references).
forbidden: aiask-quant-core must not import strategy_factory, akshare_mcp or aiask_agent.
strategy-factory must not statically import akshare_mcp. The single dynamic configurator hook in runtime/default_bootstrap.py is the documented exception and is scheduled for removal.
No package may import strategy_factory.application, strategy_factory.infrastructure or strategy_factory.domain from outside strategy-factory.

exit_codes.2: completed but not clean (partial / degraded / skipped)

run_envelope.fail_closed: Unknown, empty or non-mapping results resolve to failed. An explicit success claim never overrides recorded errors or degraded reasons.

factory_domain.notes: record_schema_namespace_checkpoint hashes only a module-name string and refreshes its checksum on drift, so it cannot prove a move preserved structure. Use the structural fingerprint for migrations.

market_domain.notes: Raw market data never moves with the factory domain. The StrategyFactoryRepository protocol currently mixes 4 market-data methods (get_klines, get_limit_up_stats, get_factor_ic_history, list_stock_universe) with 32 factory-domain methods; it must be split before the tables move.

provider_registry.notes: All providers are registered in one call, so ownership migration replaces one registration point rather than editing every call site.

fragment_debt_budget.notes: 2026-07-16: all exec_fragments/exec_block consumers migrated to ordinary modules; unused *_parts directories and _fragment_loader.py removed from packages. Budget is zero.

metric_semantics.missing: null/None — critical hard gates fail with missing_*; never coerce to 0 for admission.
metric_semantics.undefined_excellence: None (never 999.0) for Sortino/Calmar/Omega/profit_factor when denominator is zero; do not rank as excellent.
